on_shared_budget_exhaustion: discard concurrently produced graph; retain deterministic discovery diagnostics
policy_basis: Versioned bounded defaults; not claimed as production sizing evidence

result_memory.unit: logical working-set estimate, not Go heap or RSS
charges_before: snapshot backing allocation and size-change probe
fixed schema conversion and decoder working copies
result_memory.shared_once: POM analysis cache keys and identical material ids
derived_caps: Raw reads reserve an exact geometric backing array before reading; snapshots allocate declared bytes and use one extra byte only to detect input changes. Old buffers remain charged.

JSON reserves decoder buffers and raw token bounds before Token, then 4KiB per fixed DTO/index/library value and 24x string bytes before conversion. TOML/YAML fixed record conversions reserve equivalent node/string allowances before downstream DTOs, native IDs, indexes or JSON bridging.

Line-record conversions reserve 4KiB plus 256x line bytes. Bundler uses explicit Grow/Insert reservations; Yarn uses a preflight per block and descriptor. MIME records reserve 8KiB plus 512x input bytes before stdlib header mapping.

Go 1.22 buildinfo preflight reserves 32MiB initial saferio allowance, 16x file bytes, table counts, compressed ELF expansion and actual PE/Mach-O symbol name copies before the stdlib reader. Name lengths are indexed once to prevent repeated quadratic scans.
ZIP central records and decompressor buffers are checked before archive/zip allocation. RPM pages/records have explicit visit, bytes, record and result budgets.

Model normalization reserves fixed containers, geometric copies, JSON escaping and key storage before mutation. Identity/observation/requirement ASCII fast paths are byte-compared to encoding/json by tests.
Error exhaustion has one fixed emergency diagnostic; it cannot append one emergency record per subsequent failure. A failed shared result budget discards the graph.
MergePackages retains its no-error compatibility signature: budget failure returns the original slice without partially mutating representatives. MergePackagesBudget returns the typed error.
unbounded_runtime: Go allocator size-class rounding, stacks, GC and process RSS are outside the logical allocation estimate.

The caller supplies immutable fs.FS and any trusted custom analyzer. Allocations inside that caller implementation (including its ReadDir inventory) are not controlled by the SCA budget. SCA-owned copies are budgeted.

strict_preallocation_status: SCA-controlled backing growth, grammar containers, fixed conversions, executable/archive metadata and graph normalization reserve their documented logical allowance before allocation. This is a bounded logical working-set contract, not an operating-system heap/RSS cap. Fixed bootstrap/error objects and caller-owned implementations are explicitly outside the configurable result budget.
above_maximum: configuration error before scan; raising limits does not extend grammar or filesystem authority
